Senses.Note: Understanding-realization can name realization grounded in comprehension. Wuyi Yuanlai and Guifeng Zongmi explicitly contrast it with stronger or verification realization, while Yongming Yanshou conditionally commends it and Guting Shanjian warns against making it a view.

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Understanding-realization names realization grounded in comprehension, but the retained records distinguish and evaluate it in more than one way.
EvidenceBody: Yongming Yanshou conditionally commends such understanding as entry into an inconceivable means, while Guting Shanjian warns that making a view of understanding-realization and adaptability becomes an obstruction.

Wuyi Yuanlai explicitly contrasts understanding-realization gained through words with stronger penetrating realization reached through personal investigation, comparing the two to hearing about an object and seeing it directly. Guifeng Zongmi supplies a second exact contrast: sudden understanding followed by gradual cultivation is understanding-realization, whereas cultivation culminating in realization is verification-realization.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: Understanding-realization, comprehension, and realization expressed as understanding preserve the attested overlap without diagnosing every use as merely intellectual.

ModifierControls.reason: Understanding qualifies realization by its basis; bare realization and bare understanding have wider deployments.

FamilyControls.reason: Zongmi explicitly contrasts 解悟 with 證悟; this anchors a neighboring contrast without making every use a deficient intellectual category.
